# Common Pleas Court Judge Leah Dinkelacker

![](https://hamiltoncountycourts.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/05/L-Dink-Robe.jpg)

## Honorable Leah Dinkelacker

Hamilton County Courthouse

1000 Main Street

Room 560

Cincinnati, Ohio 45202

Mitch Gillen, Bailiff

Phone Number: 513-946-5750

Tom Blatz, Staff Attorney

Phone Number: 513-946-5749

Fax Number: 513-946-5751

## **COURTROOM PROCEDURES**

## **CRIMINAL CASES**

Scheduling is done through the bailiff.

I do require Defendants to be present at all court dates except DSCs.

After filing a motion, please take a copy of the motion to the courtroom and meet with the bailiff to get a hearing date.

When a case is set for trial, I expect it to go on the date set. To obtain a continuance, please file an appropriate motion.

## **CIVIL CASES**

**CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCES**

Case Management Conferences are handled by the staff attorney. The Case Management Conferences may be held via telephone. Please contact the staff attorney in advance if you need to reschedule the initial Case Management Conference.

**MOTION FILING**

After filing the motion, please take a copy of the motion to the courtroom and meet with the staff attorney to get a hearing date if needed. All Civil motions are usually heard in the afternoon at 1:00 p.m. Any motion can be set for an oral argument. I try to rule on all motions within two (2) weeks of arguments.

**SETTLEMENT**

Attorneys are encouraged to reach case resolution on their own. The Court will assist in settlement discussions in civil cases if requested.

**CONTINUANCES**

When a case is set for trial, I expect it to go on the date set. To obtain a continuance, please file an appropriate motion.

**PRETRIAL CONFERENCES**

Pretrial statements are due 1 week prior to the pretrial conference. Counsel should follow the format of the Local Rules.All counsel and clients are required to appear in person at Pretrial Conferences.

**CIVIL JURY TRIAL**

Proposed jury instructions should be filed and emailed to the staff attorney at least two weeks before trial. Please send these in Word format for easy editing. If testimony is to be presented by videotape or deposition, objections should be presented at least one week before trial.

**COURTROOM ETIQUETTE**

Counsel is expected to be professional, respectful, and courteous at all times. My staff and I will act in the same manner.

**AVAILABLILTY**

I will make myself available to counsel to help resolve any problems.
